notes.title: Sheeple 1.0
notes.content:
Hello there, Sheeple!It's Leon Here, today I'm here to spotlight for you guys a 1.0 update for Sheeple. It is an absolute ton of fixes so brace yourselves!


Sheeple now has Audio Settings! Yes now you can actually turn off all the audio in the game without using outside options. The army system had been overhauled. New units and new cards are in the game as well as a multiplayer system which is locked from the Demo had been added. Also the game is now available in 37 languages!


Change Log
Dead Units no longer appear above live units.

A text saying "loading text" had been added to the loading screen.

The "hit sound" volume is 0.1 lower now.

A baby lock had been added to the Deck Building Screen, you can no longer start a battle without cards selected.

 Pixel ratios on all unit shadow shad been fixed

The trigger distances for "enter battle" button had been changed to avoid it flying in/out of the screen to frequently

A baby lock had been added to the Army Building Screen, you can no longer start a battle without units selected.

The delay when clicking "OK" on tutorial screens had been deleted

The mini menu now has Audio Options

The mini menu now has a link to our discord

The mini menu now has a link to wish list Sheeple on steam

The transparancy of the map side lock in the army set-up had been lowered

The particle effect following player in the campaign had been fixed

Card description is now displayed in the deck building

Card lore is now displayed in the deck building

After casting a card players will now be shown the skulls they spent

Changed Start Button font

Changed Start Counting Font

Changed Start Button Graphics

Fixed Start button and number to pixel ratios

Added the countdown sound effect when starting

Maded the damage text bigger at max size (more impactfull)

The damage text dissapeares faster

Added an option to Showcase the character stats when clicked on \[3]

Added an option to turn of edge camera moving

The text now reverses when a language which is reverses is chosen

Texts which are english only don't get reversed when reverse reading languages are chosen

Added Ghoul Summoner as a new unit

Added Blur Post-Processing

Spitters Skulls changed from 3 to 11

Summoner Skulls changed from 3 to 14

Ghould Skulls Changed from 4 to 1

Added Option to turn thr Glow Off/On

Added an idle animation to the golden flag

Players no Longer get a card after loosing a battle

Showcase the character stats when dragged on in army set-up added

Added a transition from the army-setup to Deckbuilding

Added a transition from the overworld to tbe army-setup

Added an Option to exit army set-up screen and escape from battle


We are organizing an event called Glimmer Jam now!
It is a 2 hours game Jam organized weekly at 19:13 CEST, this weeks edition is on Saturday, See you there!


Have a prosperous day,Leon :D

During the last week, I was mostly focused on preparing the architecture for the big features, which you'll see next week, so be ready!

lowered summon undead card range from 7 to 6

notes.title: Sheeple Shops
notes.content:
Hello There, Sheeple!

In Sheeple, there is a Shop system that allows players to buy new units!
There are 3 different shopkeepers, each with a different fraction of units they can sell. Each time you finish a battle, the amount of shopkeepers in the shop space is being randomised as well as: the shopkeepers themself, the units they are selling, and the terrain in the shop. To buy units in the shop, you need to have sheep which are later sacrificed to the shopkeepers as payment. To gain sheep, you need to finish a battle with spare skulls. After each battle, all your skulls are converted into sheep at a ratio of 130 skulls to one sheep.

notes.title: Sheeple Release Date
notes.content:
Hello there, Sheeple!

Sheeple was originally planned to be released in September. Still, because I would like to take additional time testing & polishing the game when it is in its Demo version, I've decided to delay the release up to November. The precise date of the game's release will be announced later when I work out the details.

To celebrate the change of the release date into one more set in stone, I present before you a new Sheeple Battle Trailer!
